title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-18
lineage: 1st generation reels (Technics RS1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (.wav 24/96) > Adobe Audition 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Source A: Master Audience Cassettes; unknown taper, unknown equipment > 1st generation reels. This source supplies several minutes of the crowd/tuning before "Bertha", as well as "Bertha" in its entirety. This source also supplies the balance of the show after Source B cuts towards the end of "Dark Star"  Source B: Master Audience Cassette; unknown taper, unknown equipment > 1st generation reels. This source supplies some of the banter and tunings before "Bertha", and "Truckin' thru the cut towards the end of "Dark Star"

ai_review.summary: Excellent vintage audience tape that sounds surprisingly clear and captures a solid Dead performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praised this old audience recording, noting its surprising clarity for a tape over 50 years old. While no specific songs or performance details were mentioned, the general enjoyment suggests a competent show captured well enough to be highly listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating is 4.5; reviewers are enthusiastic about the audio quality and overall listening experience despite limited detail on musical performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear for a decades‑old audience tape, minimal hiss and good balance noted by reviewers.
